tool_permissions.unsupported: codex-cli 0.148.0 restricts by sandbox CLASS, not by tool name: `codex exec -s|--sandbox` takes read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access and there is no per-tool allow-list flag (no --allowedTools analogue) to map a seat's declared tools onto; --ask-for-approval exists on the interactive `codex` but not on `codex exec`
